ITA-1.9.3.7.4 vanaspatiḥ वनस्पतिः
Plant bearing fruits only
A plant which does not bear visible flowers (apushpa) such as the flowerless Ficus glomerata (uduṃbara) or Ficus benghalensis (vaṭa).

.21 vanopalā, vanotpalā, vanyopalā, karīṣaḥ वनोपला, वनोत्पला, वन्योपला, करीषः
Cow-dung cake
Cattle droppings which dry naturally in the open fields. Each approximately weighs around 50 to 75 grams.

ITA-1.9.3.7.5 vānaspatya वानस्पत्य
Plant bearing flowers and fruits
A plant which bears visible flowers and fruits such as Mangifera indica (amra) or Syzyigium cumini (jambu).

ITA-2.8.29 vānaspatyakāyaḥ वानस्पत्यकायः
Person with lazy, unintelligent temperament
The characteristics of the person with a lazy, unintelligent temperament are a preference for being sedentary, an excess craving for food, a lack of feeling for tranquillity, soft deeds, no inclination for righteous or religious activities, a lack of passions and no desire for wealth.
